title: Power series are complete for the ideal of the variables
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $d\ge0$, $R=A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ the formal power series ring [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] and $I=(X_1,\ldots,X_d)\subseteq R$ the ideal generated by the variables. Then $R$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring].
